title: Honeywell Technologies named a leader in 2026 Quality Management System Technology Value Matrix
summary: Nucleus Research names Honeywell a Leader in the 2026 QMS Technology Value Matrix, recognizing TrackWise Digital’s life sciences quality capabilities.
body_markdown:
Honeywell Technologies has been named a Leader in the[2026 Quality Management System Technology Value Matrix](https://hcenews.honeywell.com/Nucleus-Report.html) from independent research firm Nucleus Research, which recognized the depth of[TrackWise Digital’s](https://www.spartasystems.com/trackwise/) quality management capabilities for life sciences organizations and its configurability across complex, multi-site environments.


The report evaluates 21 quality management system (QMS) providers based on usability and functionality as organizations increasingly look to connect quality processes across product development, manufacturing, suppliers and regulatory operations. Nucleus Research identified Honeywell Technologies as one of six vendors in the Leader quadrant, denoting offerings that excel in functionality and usability with comprehensive solutions.


*“Life sciences companies operate in one of the world’s most demanding quality environments, where the ability to identify risk earlier and act on trusted information can have a significant impact on operations,”* said Jim Masso, president and CEO of Honeywell Technologies Process Automation. *“This recognition reflects our continued investment in helping customers connect quality processes across their organizations and use AI and automation to make quality management more proactive, efficient and resilient.”*


Honeywell Technologies’ TrackWise Digital is a cloud-based quality management platform used by regulated life sciences organizations to manage quality and compliance processes across global operations. Nucleus Research highlighted the platform’s breadth of capabilities, configurability for complex, multisite environments, and embedded AI tools that support quality investigations, complaint management, and quality insights that to help organizations identify risk earlier and make more proactive decisions.


" *Honeywell Technologies demonstrates a clear understanding of where life sciences quality management needs to go, applying automation and AI to some of the industry's most time-intensive, complex, and highly regulated processes* ,” said Marisa Modjeski, Nucleus Research Analyst. “ *What distinguishes its approach is the combination of deep industry expertise and practical innovation, reducing the administrative burden of quality investigations, complaint handling, and corrective actions while preserving the oversight and accountability these processes demand. With TrackWise Digital, Honeywell Technologies is advancing a more proactive model of quality management where technology supports experienced professionals in identifying risks earlier, making informed decisions, and maintaining regulatory confidence.* ”


The recognition comes as organizations increasingly look to connect quality processes across product development, manufacturing, supplier and regulatory operations while using AI to improve visibility, consistency and risk management.


For more information on how Honeywell Technologies’ portfolio was evaluated, access the[Nucleus Research’s Quality Management System Technology Value Matrix 2026](https://hcenews.honeywell.com/Nucleus-Report.html) report.


To dive deeper into TrackWise Digital’s market differentiators, access the report[Anatomy of a decision: Honeywell Technologies TrackWise Digital](https://hcenews.honeywell.com/Nucleus-Report-Anatomy-of-Decision.html) .
